source: GitHub connector normalized per-PR metadata from fetch_pr; body/issue summaries cross-checked with fetch_issue/search_prs
slice: nominal continuation slice(20,30), PR #427–#436; individually fetched rather than raw list-page response

records.title: feat(home): wire canonical Task editor apply path
records.body: Home edit wired through TaskEditApplyService; preserves Task identity and canonical Home persistence; dueDate/category/checklist/reminder/recurrence use same apply path.

records.title: feat(followup): project due reminder deliveries
records.body: Projects canonical FollowUp.reminderDate due/overdue candidates; skips completed/archived/trashed Tasks; exact delivery identity includes Task + FollowUp + timestamp; pure projection, no scheduler side effects.

records.title: feat(followup): rebuild reminder alarm planner after editor merge
records.body: Pure planner for nearest pending canonical FollowUp.reminderDate; skips delivered identities; changed timestamps become new work; no platform side effects. Body states superseded by #433.

records.title: feat(bulk): rebuild preselected report export on current main
records.body: Reuses existing PDF/print/share report page with canonical Task ids; copies caller selection; preserves single/selected/all report behavior; no new report model/store/renderer.

records.title: feat(followup): reuse existing notification channel for reminders
records.body: Extends existing AutomaticFollowUpNotificationService to deliver canonical FollowUp Reminder candidates using the existing notification plugin/channel; no second service/channel/store. Closed unmerged; current-main equivalence still to verify.

records.title: fix(followup): ignore inactive reminder scheduling
records.body: Ensures pending FollowUp reminder projection excludes completed, archived and trashed Tasks consistently; regression coverage for inactive Tasks; no model/store/alarm/notification changes.

records.title: feat(followup): arbitrate one alarm for all followup schedules
records.body: Pure arbiter chooses one nearest schedule across automatic FollowUp and independent FollowUp reminders, reuses single Android alarm foundation; no model/storage/platform side effects. Current-main equivalence still to verify.

records.title: feat(task): rebuild due-date editor after Home integration
records.body: Dedicated Jalali Due Date editor, independent of Task Reminder and FollowUp; create/edit/preserve/clear through Task.dueDate; body says fresh rebuild after #427 and earlier #422.

records.title: feat(followup): add reminder delivery metadata state
records.body: Metadata-only delivery state for independent FollowUp reminders, persisted via one SharedPreferences metadata key, no second domain store or TaskStore schema change; reconciles metadata when canonical reminder is removed.

records.title: feat(bulk): expose archive in shared selection bar
records.body: Adds Archive action to existing shared TaskBulkSelectionBar while preserving Trash/Category/Tags/Share and compact-width safety; no Home wiring in this slice.

integrity.rest_numeric_id: not exposed by the connector; stored as null, not inferred
